Vendored schemas, unmodified.

factura_V1.1.0.xsd
  Source: SRI, "XML y XSD Factura" bundle (factura_V1.0.0 / 1.1.0 / 2.0.0 / 2.1.0)
  URL:    https://www.sri.gob.ec/o/sri-portlet-biblioteca-alfresco-internet/descargar/05546998-6f29-4870-be3b-62650f312a6c/XML%20y%20XSD%20Factura.zip
  Fetched 2026-08-25; sha256 62db9bf0ecceb00ef2b7ed136e59224815e5e5e33c77efc6a0552001e052eb8b
  (file dated 2022-02-07 inside the zip; the same bytes are vendored by at least five
  independent open-source SRI implementations on GitHub).
  Known lag behind Ficha Tecnica v2.34: the contribuyenteRimpe pattern only admits
  "CONTRIBUYENTE RÉGIMEN RIMPE"; the Ficha (Anexo 22) also defines
  "CONTRIBUYENTE NEGOCIO POPULAR - RÉGIMEN RIMPE", which this XSD rejects.

NotaCredito_V1.1.0.xsd
  Source: SRI, "XML y XSD Nota de Crédito" bundle (NotaCredito_V1.0.0 / 1.1.0)
  URL:    https://www.sri.gob.ec/o/sri-portlet-biblioteca-alfresco-internet/descargar/dfc944cd-5f18-4433-a626-3cc64cfc4549/XML%20y%20XSD%20Nota%20de%20Cr%c3%a9dito.zip
  Vendored 2026-08-25; sha256 379e9f270d71ab4578f130a736c9abe5eb1d7969375ecdef55d2973583ec5ab0.
  The SRI's host reset every download that day, so the bytes were taken from
  xprl-gjf/sri-efactura-core (sri-efactura-model/src/main/sri/META-INF/schema/v1.1.0),
  whose vendored factura_V1.1.0.xsd is byte-identical to the one above; three more
  independent GitHub vendorings (cuymo/facturacion-electronica-ec, nulldoomer/Open-SRI,
  grisbi-ia/key49) carry the same sha256. Its declaration says XML 1.1, which xmllint
  warns about and then honours.
  Same RIMPE lag as the factura schema. Note the schema's totalImpuesto has no
  tarifa element (the factura's does), and there is no pagos block.
